description: Pure graph computation over a crawled page set. Input: an array of {url, internalLinks: [{href, anchor}, ...], title?, bodyText?}. Returns orphan pages (in-degree 0, excluding the homepage), hubs (top-N by in-degree), authorities (top-N by out-edges to hubs), PageRank-lite ranking, anchor-diversity issues (all-anchors-same, no-descriptive-anchors), connected components, and isolated clusters. With options.findMentions=true and title+bodyText supplied, also returns mention-not-linked suggestions. URL normalization (trailing slash, lowercased host, dropped utm_*/fbclid/gclid/etc.) is on by default.

authorityCount.description: Number of top authorities to return. Default 10.

findMentions.description: Default false. If true (and pages include title+bodyText), include mentioned-not-linked suggestions. O(N^2) — slow on large inputs.

hubCount.description: Number of top hubs to return. Default 10.

normalizeUrls.description: Default true. Strip trailing slashes, lowercase host, drop tracking params.

rankingLimit.description: Max ranking entries to return. Default 50.

name: compute_link_graph
